name: Konoha Mission Team A2B320A362 Combat Doctrine
motto: See together. Move together. Finish together.

phases.name: SEE
phases.objective: Establish positions, threats, routes, and uncertainty before committing force.
procedures: Cross-check observations before acting on them.

phases.name: SHAPE
phases.objective: Alter movement, terrain, information, or routes to create team advantage.
procedures: Create openings for teammates rather than isolated duels.

phases.name: BREAK
phases.objective: Exploit the shaped engagement to disrupt coherent enemy action.

phases.name: SECURE
phases.objective: Complete the authorized objective and stabilize control.

phases.name: EXTRACT
phases.objective: Account for the team and remove personnel, captives, evidence, or protected assets safely.
procedures: Preserve command and a viable withdrawal route.

standing_rules.name: Shared objective
standing_rules.rule: Openings belong to the team, not the individual who created them.
procedures: Exploit teammate-created advantages when lawful and useful.

standing_rules.name: Mission first
standing_rules.rule: Do not trade the assigned objective for an unnecessary fight.
procedures: Reorient when combat no longer advances the mission.

standing_rules.name: Recover control
standing_rules.rule: When coordination breaks, restore information, command, spacing, and an exit before escalating.
procedures: Stabilize before chasing a collapsing plan.

mission_modes.directive: Verify while preserving concealment and a report route.
Create control, restrain the authorized target, and preserve evidence.
Keep the protected person or asset viable and preserve extraction.
Concentrate complementary roles on the mission-critical threat.

loss_of_control: Create a regroup or withdrawal route.

procedures: Account for every member and material objective before disengagement.

training.attendance_rule: Training credit requires actual lawful attendance under the team training model.
training.interrupt_rule: Missions, injury, travel, or higher lawful orders interrupt training without double counting.
